__comment: SINGLE SOURCE for retired Axiomancer terminology. scripts/check-lexicon.mjs (repo root) enforces this registry against every live prose surface in CI; docs/LEXICON.md is the human-readable mirror with the canonical-terms guide. To retire a concept: add a row here, run the lint, fix what it flags — that IS the cleanup. Patterns are JS regexes (case-sensitive unless the pattern says otherwise). Legitimate mentions of a retired term (e.g. 'basePower no longer exists') stay allowed via a file-level pragma: <!-- lexicon-ok: <id>, <id> -->. Files whose head carries '**Status:** HISTORICAL' are dated records and exempt entirely.
